title: Economic development, political-economic system, and the physical quality of life
author: Cereseto S, Waitzkin H
summary: The paper. AJPH 76(6):661-666. World Bank data, 123 countries (~97% of world pop), countries grouped by 1981 GNP/capita; socialist better in 28 of 30 comparisons.
key_points: Low-income stratum reportedly has ONE socialist country (China) vs 33 capitalist; no high-income socialist countries; ~13 socialist countries total. Full text blocked by network - READ IT.

title: Capitalism, socialism, and the physical quality of life
author: Cereseto S, Waitzkin H
summary: Companion version in Int J Health Serv 16(4):643-658. Reports 30 of 36 comparisons favour socialism (p<.05).
key_points: Two versions with different counts.

title: OCR copy of the AJPH paper

summary: Table 1 strata sizes seen via search snippets only.
